errors.text_span: Die schwarze Linie startet bei etwa 40 % mit 20 Jahren
errors.evidence: The description states the black line starts at approximately 40% at age 20, but the figure clearly shows it starts at approximately 55%.

errors.text_span: fluktuiert zwischen etwa 40 % und 60 % bis zum Alter von 60 Jahren
errors.evidence: This is an oversimplification of the trend for the black line. The line dips below 40% (to ~38%) and peaks above 60% (to ~68%), so the stated range is not fully representative.
The description states that the gray line rises to about 80% at age 45, but the graph shows that it reaches this level much earlier, around age 30.

errors.text_span: Die hellblaue Linie startet bei etwa 80 % bei 20 Jahren
errors.evidence: The description states the light blue line starts at approximately 80% at age 20, but the figure shows it starting at approximately 75%.

errors.text_span: Die dunkelblaue Linie beginnt bei etwa 60 % bei 20 Jahren
errors.evidence: The description states the dark blue line starts at approximately 60% at age 20, but the figure shows it starting lower, at approximately 55%.

errors.text_span: bleibt bis etwa 60 Jahre relativ stabil bei rund 90 %
errors.evidence: For the dark blue line, it does not remain stable at around 90%. It peaks at over 90% (approx. 92% at age 48) but also has significant portions below 90%, for example around age 40 (approx. 82%) and age 55 (approx. 85%). Describing it as stable 'at' 90% is inaccurate.
